summary: Phase 1 strategy created for teacher content authoring. It defines the required Red command, Green and closeout gates, fixture/mock/live-proof expectations, artifact-vs-live test distinctions, architecture guardrails, changed-contract risks, intentionally-red aggregate-suite handling, and A1-A10 anti-pattern defenses. nonblocking_findings: Runtime activity registry includes placeholder keys without canonical schemas; Phase 1 tests must reject or mark these unsupported rather than allowing arbitrary props.
Convex activityPropsValidator is a broad union not keyed by componentKey; Phase 1 validation must bind getPropsSchema(componentKey) to props.
Existing ActivityReviewHarness is placeholder-like; Phase 1 must not claim student-accurate preview until Phase 3.
known_failures: None introduced. Required RED_TEST_COMMAND/GREEN_TEST_COMMAND were documented, not executed as product tests because this strategy pass did not add implementation tests. Pre-existing untracked _add_types.py and _add_types.ts preserved out of scope.
handoff: Mid Red should add failing Phase 1 tests under apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/teacher/content-authoring/ plus any schema parity guard, run CI=true npx vitest run apps/integrated-math-3 packages/activity-components, and verify failures are attributable to the new Phase 1 tests. Green should implement pure app-local model/validation/sanitization using canonical SCHEMA_REGISTRY/getPropsSchema and keep persistence, approval, publishing, and full composer UI out of Phase 1.
